svg.title: DRAWBRIDGE, section A–A, detail 1 enlarged
svg.desc: An architect's section through the gatehouse, labelled from the source. 1, the guard, removes X-Authenticated-*, X-Drawbridge-*, X-Sesame-*, OIDC-Claim-* and trims Connection to close, keep-alive, upgrade. 2, the OpenID Connect client: response type code, PKCE S256, callback /_drawbridge/oidc/callback, claims kept in the environment. 3, the signer: drawbridge+jwt, ES256, 60 seconds, sent as X-Sesame-Assertion; if it cannot sign the answer is 503. A door schedule shows /up and /assets/ public, /admin/ and anything else login, /api/ api.
